title: PBMC Isolation
author: Dannielle DK Moore
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yf2ftqe
materials: Following layering, secure and remove tubes from hood.

steps.title: Prepare Ficoll Density Gradient
steps.instruction: Decant 15 mL of Ficoll-Paque PLUS density gradient media (GE Healthcare Catalog #17144002) into a 50 mL Falcon Tube (Fischer Scientific).

steps.title: Dilute Peripheral Blood
steps.instruction: Dilute peripheral blood in a 1:1 ratio with 1x Phosphate-Buffered Saline (Lonza Catalog #04-479Q) in a separate 50 mL Falcon Tube (Fischer Scientific).

substeps.instruction: Ensure max volume is 35 mL (max starting blood volume ~18 mL).
If larger blood volumes are required, split blood across separate Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Layer Blood onto Ficoll
steps.instruction: Gently layer the diluted blood from the previous step onto the Ficoll.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 400xg for 25 minutes at 23 °C (Room temp) with the accelerator and brake set to OFF.

steps.title: Sterilize and Process Tubes
steps.instruction: Sterilize tubes following centrifugation and return them to the hood for further processing.

steps.title: Collect PBMC Band
steps.instruction: Isolate the PBMC band using a sterile Pasteur pipette.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the upper plasma layer until 5 cm above the opaque PBMC band.
Collect the PBMC band at the Ficoll interface using a circular motion.
Transfer the band into a new 50 mL Falcon Tube (Fischer Scientific).
If blood was split into several tubes, collect and decant all PBMC bands into a single tube.

steps.title: Wash Isolated PBMCs
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated PBMCs twice in 20 mL 1x Phosphate-Buffered Saline (Lonza Catalog #04-479Q).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 400xg for 10 minutes at 23 °C (Room temp).
Set the brake and accelerator to max.

steps.title: Count Cells and Assess Viability
steps.instruction: Dilute cells in a 1:10 ratio with 1x Phosphate-Buffered Saline (Lonza Catalog #04-479Q) and 0.4% Sterile-filtered Trypan Blue Solution (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #T8154).

substeps.instruction: Count the cells using a haemocytometer and microscope.
Record the observed cell number and cell viability.
